notes: Use-case summary: low-latency personalized recommendations + re-ranking for product search; also chat use for checkout support.
Targets: p50 latency target for online recs = 30-50ms, p95 target <= 150ms for golden routes. Throughput target ~200 qps steady (avg 25 tokens/request) => ~5k tokens/sec baseline.
Quality constraints: cannot drop NDCG by >1.5% vs current model. Any quantization must be validated against core relevance eval set.
Model preferences: considering open-70b-ctx32k and a trimmed 33B variant. Interested in Redwood-verified quantized profiles (4-bit NF4) but require QC.
Dedicated sizing ask: initial reserved pool proposal 4x H100 (serve 200 qps with low tail), burst to 8 for promotional spikes; need guidance on autoscale policy and GPU packing.
KV cache plan: session-affinity for chat, prefix/KV caching for long-context product catalogs (average active sessions ~40k/day). Concern: cold-start cost when cache misses spike.
Batching policy: aggressive batching for background reranking jobs (large micro-batches), low-latency single-request fast-path for recommendations.
SLA negotiation points: 99.9% availability, p95 latency SLO by route, credits for sustained p95 latency breach >3 consecutive days, clarified maintenance windows.
Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "Latency is the business — if recommendations are slow we see CTR drop immediately. Need predictable tail behavior."
Security: must pass SAML SSO + KMS key wrap test; require audit trail retention 1 year and optional 7-year archive for regulated catalogs.
Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to annual reserved capacity if cost per token improvements are >=30% vs hosted API at our volumes.
Evaluation plan: phase 1 = functional perf (latency / p95) on synthetic traffic; phase 2 = accuracy/regression on eval sets; phase 3 = 2-week shadow run on live traffic.
POC data notes: will provide redacted logs and eval set (~2000 queries) — Security team needs data handling SOP before we start live shadow run.
